description: Creates an API key and returns it. It is sent as the password of HTTP basic auth, with any username. This is the only time the key can be read, and it stays in this conversation's transcript, so give it to the user to store and do not repeat it. Note: once any key exists, Uptime Kuma's /metrics endpoint takes API keys instead of the admin username and password, so a Prometheus scraper still using those must switch.

expires.description: When it stops working, in the server's local time: "YYYY-MM-DD" (end of that day) or "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm". Omit for never.

name.description: What the key is for, e.g. "prometheus"

name: createAPIKey

key.description: The key itself, e.g. "uk1_…". Shown only now.

title: Create API Key
